title: 野生眉能维持多久？留色时间怎么看
title_en: How long do hair-stroke brows last?
intro: 半永久纹绣会随时间变化。留色时间只能结合个人情况估计，不能仅凭项目名称给出保证。
intro_en: Semi-permanent pigment changes over time. Retention can only be estimated in context; a service name cannot guarantee a duration.

sections.title: 门店经验参考
sections.description: 手工野生眉通常参考约1年，单仪器与双仪器通常参考约2–3年。这些是沟通时的经验区间，不是每个人都能达到的期限。
sections.description_en: The studio commonly discusses around one year for manual brows and two to three years for single- or dual-instrument brows. These are working estimates, not guaranteed lifespans.

sections.title: 为什么会有差异
sections.description: 肤质、原有底色、操作及日常护理等因素都会影响留色。刚做完的颜色和恢复后的颜色也不同，不能只用当天照片判断后续表现。
sections.description_en: Skin, pre-existing pigment, the procedure and aftercare can affect retention. Fresh colour also differs from healed colour, so a same-day photograph does not establish long-term performance.

sections.title: 补色解决什么
sections.description: 恢复后如有局部留色差异，应由老师结合实际情况评估。所有项目一年内免费补色，具体安排先沟通，不要因为颜色暂时变化就急于再次操作。
sections.description_en: Uneven retention after healing should be assessed by the practitioner. All services include free touch-ups within one year. Discuss timing instead of rushing to repeat treatment when colour changes during recovery.
